summary: The endpoint proof is correct: the homothetic cap estimates force strong positive support bounds for P, their weighted combination gives delta > 3(d_x+d_y), and concavity of the coordinate-section lengths of Q, together with the lower-crossing hypotheses, yields D_X < 3d_x and D_Y < 3d_y. Hence every point of Q satisfies X+Y > -delta > -2-delta, proving the stated full-area conclusion. The full no-realization assertion then follows directly from its included endpoint hypotheses and the contradictory 3s/4 area condition.
